cpextended.warning.title: Chat Patches Extended
cpextended.warning.degraded: Compatibility problem with Chat Patches. Hiding is off for this session; tabs keep working.
cpextended.warning.tab_suspended: Tab "%s" hit an error and is suspended until you restart the game.
cpextended.warning.search_unavailable: Chat Patches search state can't be read. Search integration is off for this session.
cpextended.warning.internal: An internal error occurred. Chat works normally; see the log for details.
cpextended.warning.config_no_save: cpextended.json can't be used as is. Saving is disabled; see the log for the file and backup involved.
cpextended.warning.config_divergence: cpextended.json changed and can't be applied. Saving is disabled until you apply or overwrite the file.
cpextended.warning.config_not_saved: Settings were not saved. They stay in memory and saving is retried later.
cpextended.warning.lines_dirty: Chat display needs a refresh; reopen chat or rejoin.
cpextended.gui.title: Chat Patches Extended
cpextended.gui.state.no_save: Saving disabled: cpextended.json can't be used as is
cpextended.gui.state.divergence: Saving disabled: cpextended.json changed and can't be applied
cpextended.gui.apply_file.confirm: Replace the settings in use with the contents of cpextended.json?
cpextended.gui.overwrite_file.confirm: Overwrite cpextended.json with the settings in use? The changes made to the file will be lost.
cpextended.gui.restore_backup.confirm: Replace cpextended.json with %1$s (saved %2$s) and use it? %3$s
cpextended.gui.replace_file.confirm: Replace cpextended.json with the settings currently in use?
cpextended.gui.delete_tab.confirm: Delete the tab "%s"? Its filters are removed from cpextended.json.
cpextended.gui.name: Name
cpextended.gui.hide.tooltip: Matching messages are kept out of the main chat and shown only in this tab. Hidden messages are kept for this session only (up to Chat Patches' history limit); Chat Patches' chat log is not a guaranteed backup. Deleting this tab later moves its hidden messages back to the main chat, or is refused if that would lose any of them.
cpextended.gui.orphans.title: Move hidden messages back to the main chat?
cpextended.gui.orphans.message: %1$s hidden message(s) held only by %2$s will return to the main chat in their original order. No visible message will be pruned.
cpextended.gui.orphans.message_pruned: %1$s hidden message(s) held only by %2$s will return to the main chat in their original order. %3$s older visible message(s) will be pruned by Chat Patches' history limit and may not be recoverable.
cpextended.gui.delete_window.choose: Delete %s: move or delete each tab
cpextended.gui.hiding.tooltip: Global switch for hiding routed messages from the main chat. Turning it off keeps already hidden messages in their tabs. Hidden messages are kept for this session only; Chat Patches' chat log is not a guaranteed backup.
cpextended.gui.hiding.paused.tooltip: Hiding is paused for this session because of a compatibility problem with Chat Patches (see the log). Tabs keep receiving messages; hidden ones stay in their tabs.
cpextended.gui.restore_backup.corrupt_ke: The damaged file stays available as %s.
cpextended.gui.restore_backup.replaced: The current cpextended.json will be overwritten.
cpextended.gui.restore_backup.tooltip: Restores %1$s: your settings as they were before the last change saved in game (saved %2$s). Hidden-message safety checks still apply.
cpextended.gui.empty: No chat windows yet. A window is a separate chat view on screen, and each of its tabs collects the messages its filters match (optionally hiding them from the main chat). Click "Add window" below to create one, then add tabs to it.
cpextended.gui.move_target.tooltip: Destination: %s. Click to choose another window.
cpextended.gui.case.insensitive: Case-insensitive (aa): matches any capitalization. Click to match the exact capitalization (Aa).
cpextended.gui.case.sensitive: Case-sensitive (Aa): matches only this exact capitalization. Click to ignore capitalization (aa).
cpextended.gui.restore.tooltip: Messages Chat Patches restores from its chat log when the game starts are routed to this tab too, and hidden from the main chat if this tab hides. A message that was visible when it first arrived can be hidden after a restart this way.
